title: The capture turnstile spent the repository's whole GitHub API quota, and a refused API read became the preview URL Playwright ran against, so PRs went red on tests they never ran

source.ref: 2026-09-29 GITHUB_TOKEN core quota at 0 twice (x-ratelimit-reset 22:52Z and 23:52Z); #3066 pr-compare run 36636201158 job 109638485701 ran with PW_BASE_URL set to a GitHub 404 error body

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1669). PREMISE RE-TESTED (ADR-1082) on main 645681934 and on the run. (1) The turnstile (six byte-identical copies across e2e.yml and e2e-manual.yml) made one paginated listWorkflowRuns per lane file plus one listJobsForWorkflowRun for EVERY in-progress run, every 30 s, in every waiting job: run under a fake Octokit, main's script spends 12 requests on one look behind a capture plus nine waiters, so ten waiters cost ~14,400 requests an hour against a 1,000/h quota, and a refused look was simply polled again 30 s later. (2) #3066's pr-compare held its turnstile for the full 90-minute bound (21:58:01Z to 23:28:01Z, inside the spent hour), resolved in under a second, and ran every suite with PW_BASE_URL = {"message":"Not Found",...,"status":"404"} (the job log's step env): the resolver's `|| true` swallowed the refused deployments read, gh printed its error body to stdout, the body was word-split into deployment ids, each statuses read 404'd, and that 404 body became the URL. Playwright then failed the smoke, public and shell tiers with "Cannot navigate to invalid URL". The premise said an EMPTY base URL; the measured value was an error body, and an empty one would have been a vacuous green (every spec skips itself). Replaying the refusal against main's resolver with a fake gh reproduces the exact value.

FIX. Turnstile: one listWorkflowRunsForRepo read a look filtered to the lane files; jobs read oldest-first, stopping at the first run ahead; newer runs seen waiting twice not re-read; TURNSTILE_POLL_SECONDS 30 -> 120, stretched by min(older lane runs in progress, 3); new rule 6 waits out a 403/429 with retry-after or x-ratelimit-remaining 0 until the reset, never past the 90-minute bound. Ten waiters: ~14,400/h -> 250/h. The one-capture-at-a-time rule (ADR-1328/1331), the lane and rule 5's ceiling are unchanged. Resolver: every read goes through read_api (prints nothing on failure, records why); a refusal checks /rate_limit (free) and sleeps out a reset inside the existing 12-minute window, or fails at once naming the reset time in the log and job summary; a refused last look or a refused pending-classification fails instead of reaching the quiet green; a non-https value fails the step. Playwright: playwright.config.ts exports refuseUnusableBaseUrl, which refuses a non-URL PW_BASE_URL anywhere and an empty one on GitHub Actions; the lighthouse step refuses a non-URL PREVIEW_URL. Pinned by scripts/e2e-preview-gate.test.ts (resolver under bash with a fake gh, turnstile under a fake Octokit and clock, config guard), every arm watched red against main and against a targeted mutation.

verify.note: Replays #3066: runs pr-compare's resolver step from e2e.yml under bash with a fake gh that refuses the deployments read (quota 0, reset 50 min away) and 404s everything else, as the real gh does (error body on stdout); fails if GITHUB_OUTPUT gets url= or ready=true, if the step ends 0, or if it does not say the API refused. Then runs pr-compare's turnstile script under a fake Octokit and clock: behind a capture plus nine waiters one look must cost at most 3 requests and the next look must be at least 90 s away; refused with x-ratelimit-remaining 0 and a reset 1,800 s away, the next look must wait for the reset. Last, imports playwright.config.ts: refuseUnusableBaseUrl must throw for a GitHub error body and for an empty base on Actions, and accept a real preview URL. Fails on main 645681934 at the first arm (the resolver hands Playwright the 404 body); mutation-fired per arm: main's turnstile alone (12 requests a look), the quota wait disabled (120 s), main's playwright.config.ts (no refusal). Exit 79 if the workflow, the config or the turnstile script cannot be found.
